title: a sign-off
description: What the orchestrator puts up for the user's /rn:ty or /rn:gm by tree.py sign-off: the plan, a deliverable, or a lesson for rn's repository. tree.py keeps it in the run's sign-offs.json until the user's command decides it.

of.description: What the sign-off is of: `plan`, the path of a deliverable of the design tree, or `lesson`.

can_do.description: What the deliverable's people can do with it, or, for the plan, the goal it serves. Empty for a lesson.

decisions.description: Each decision taken without asking the user, in a line, so that the user sees what rn settled for them.

words.description: For a lesson, its words, exactly as the issue on rn's repository will hold them, as no AI may send what the user didn't read. Empty otherwise.
